name: Salesforce
verdict: No vendor review, but the rules changed twice in a year. New apps are External Client Apps, and since September 2025 each customer's admin may need to approve your app before their users can connect.

creation.label: Moderate
creation.note: External Client App in a Developer Edition org. Not tested by us.

approval.label: Admin-gated
approval.note: No Salesforce review, but customer admins decide.

handsOn.note: App, policies, and a customer-admin enablement note.

ownApp.headline: Often your own app.
ownApp.note: Composio lists private Salesforce subdomains as a reason to bring your own app.

oneWayDoors.title: Connected Apps can no longer be created.
oneWayDoors.detail: From Spring '26, creating Connected Apps is off by default in UI and API. Support can grant a temporary exception that Salesforce says will be removed.

oneWayDoors.title: Your home org matters.
oneWayDoors.detail: Packaged apps can depend on the org that owns them.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Keep a dedicated Developer Edition org alive for the app.

notes.title: Cross-org behaviour is unclear
notes.text: A Trailblazer thread shows OAUTH_AUTHORIZATION_BLOCKED after installing a packaged ECA, with no confirmed answer. Test with a real customer org before promising dates.

scopes.intro: Salesforce scopes are broad API grants set on the app.

minimalSets.label: "CRM assistant" agent
minimalSets.note: Add `web` only if you need it.

changingLater: Edit the app's OAuth settings; users reauthorize.

forApproval: Customer-admin instructions for approving or installing your app

steps.title: Create an External Client App
steps.detail: Setup, App Manager, New External Client App; enable OAuth.

steps.title: Set callback, scopes and policies
steps.detail: Refresh token validity and session timeout suit long-running agents.

steps.title: Reveal consumer key and secret
steps.detail: Salesforce emails a verification code first.

steps.title: Write the customer-admin note
steps.detail: How to install or approve your app, and grant the approval permission.

approval.whenNeeded: No Salesforce review for OAuth. Customer admins may need to approve your app.

stages.label: Per customer
stages.detail: Admin installs the app or grants "Approve Uninstalled Connected Apps".

ladder.works: Users authorize via login.salesforce.com or My Domain.
ladder.limit: Users need admin approval for uninstalled apps since Sept 2025.
Cross-org packaging behaviour not well documented.

tokens.note: ECAs do not support the username-password flow.

rules.title: Customer admin control.
rules.text: Admins decide which apps their users may authorize.

credentialHandoff.summary: Revealing the consumer secret needs an emailed verification code, so a human is required.

blockers.cause: Uninstalled app and user lacks approval permission
blockers.fix: Customer admin installs or approves your app

evidence.claim: Connected App creation restricted from Spring '26
evidence.basis: Salesforce Mobile SDK docs and a vendor notice
